title: Tests: complementarity, nonlocality and qubit counts in experience

statements.text: The quantum nature of consciousness could be shown by complementarity or nonlocality in experience, for example in alternative 3D views, and memory-recall experiments against attention, delay and kind of qualia could map the dimension of the systems involved.

sources.quote: In principle quantumness could be established through experimental demonstration of one of the two main nonclassical features of quantum theory: nonlocality and complementarity.
may be helpful to make a preliminary mapping of the dimensionality of the spaces of conscious systems involved
